Name: NEW NPC - Hinata
Author: alinezinhauhu
Description:
[list=1]
[b]☀️ A New Ray of Sunshine in Pelican Town![/b]
This mod adds [b]Hinata Shoyo[/b], the bright and passionate volleyball player from [i]Haikyuu!![/i], as a [b]fully custom NPC[/b] in Stardew Valley!
🏠 He comes with a [b]unique, custom-designed house[/b], built to match his personality and style.
💬 Hinata features [b]original dialogue[/b], seasonal reactions, indoor/outdoor lines, and interactions that reflect his energetic character.
Whether you're a [i]Haikyuu!![/i] fan or just want a fun new character in town, [b]this mod adds charm and freshness[/b] to your gameplay!
[line][b]✨ Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Brand-new NPC: [b]Hinata Shoyo[/b]
[*]Custom [b]house interior & exterior[/b]
[*]Personalized [b]dialogue[/b] for weather, seasons, and schedule
[*]Compatible with Content Patcher + SMAPI
[*][b]More updates coming soon[/b] (heart events, romance, etc.)
[/list][line][b]📌 Installation:[/b]Drop the folder into your [code]Mods[/code] directory. Requires [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].
[/list]
